name: core
description: Shared interaction-protocol machinery for every tokenmaxxxer role. Ships the canonical role-handoff contract (v3) and the hook set registered in hooks/hooks.json — the SessionStart briefing (directive.sh) plus deny-only PreToolUse gates and per-prompt shape directives: board-gate, approval-gate (execution-surface writes wait for a human Approve — checkpoint-aware, see the gate header), gh-guard, trailer-gate, record-fields-gate, handbook-trigger-gate, ordering-gate, ordering-norm-gate, facet-keyword-gate, citation-gate, proposal-shape, survey-order, and record-shape — all parameterized on CLAUDE_SKILL rather than vendored per role. Also ships hooks/lib/gate-lib.sh (shared gate library) and hooks/tests/ (the suite plus stub-check.sh, which catches a locally-regrown copy of any of these). Gates refuse but never permit. No version field on purpose: for a git-distributed plugin the commit SHA is the version, so every commit is an update.
